title: Inositol pyrophosphate catabolism by three families of phosphatases controls plant growth and development
authors: Laurent F; Bartsch SM; Shukla A; Rico-Resendiz F; Couto D; Fuchs C; Nicolet J; Loubéry S; Jessen HJ; Fiedler D; Hothorn M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物肌醇焦磷酸磷酸酶对生长和发育的调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
Inositol pyrophosphates (PP-InsPs) are nutrient messengers whose cellular concentration must be tightly regulated. Diphosphoinositol pentakisphosphate kinases (PPIP5Ks) generate the active signaling molecule 1,5-InsP 8 . PPIP5Ks contain additional phosphatase domains involved in PP-InsP catabolism. Plant and Fungi Atypical Dual Specificity Phosphatases (PFA-DSPs) and NUDIX phosphatases (NUDTs) also hydrolyze PP-InsPs. Here we dissect the relative contributions of the three different phosphatase families to plant PP-InsP catabolism and nutrient signaling. We report the biochemical characterization of inositol pyrophosphate phosphatases from Arabidopsis and Marchantia polymorpha . Overexpression of different PFA-DSP and NUDT enzymes affects PP-InsP levels and leads to stunted growth phenotypes in Arabidopsis. nudt17/18/21 knock-out mutants have altered PP-InsP pools and gene expression patterns, but no apparent growth defects. In contrast, Marchantia polymorpha Mp pfa-dsp1 ge , Mp nudt1 ge and Mp vip1 ge mutants display severe growth and developmental phenotypes associated with changes in cellular PP-InsP levels. Analysis of Mp pfa-dsp1 ge and Mp vip1 ge supports a role for PP-InsPs in Marchantia phosphate signaling, and additional functions in nitrate homeostasis and cell wall biogenesis. Simultaneous removal of two phosphatase activities enhances the observed growth phenotypes. Taken together, PPIP5K, PFA-DSP and NUDT inositol pyrophosphate phosphatases play important roles in growth and development by collectively shaping plant PP-InsP pools.

Author summary

Organisms must maintain adequate levels of nutrients in their cells and tissues. One such nutrient is phosphorus, an essential building block of cell membranes, nucleic acids and energy metabolites. Plants take up phosphorus in the form of inorganic phosphate and require sufficient cellular phosphate levels to support their growth and development. It has been shown that plants and other eukaryotic organisms "measure" cellular phosphate levels using inositol pyrophosphate signaling molecules. The concentration of inositol pyrophosphates serves as a proxy for the cellular concentration of inorganic phosphate, and therefore inositol pyrophosphate synthesis and degradation must be tightly regulated. Here, we report that three different families of enzymes contribute to the degradation of inositol pyrophosphates in plants. The different phosphatases together shape cellular inositol pyrophosphate pools and thereby affect inorganic phosphate levels. Loss-of-function mutants of the different enzymes display additional defects in nitrate levels and cell wall architecture, suggesting that inositol pyrophosphates regulate cellular processes beyond inorganic phosphate homeostasis.
abstract_zh:
肌醇焦磷酸（PP-InsPs）是营养信使，其细胞浓度必须受到严格调控。二磷酸肌醇五磷酸激酶（PPIP5Ks）生成活性信号分子1,5-InsP 8 。PPIP5Ks包含参与PP-InsP分解代谢的额外磷酸酶结构域。植物和真菌非典型双特异性磷酸酶（PFA-DSPs）和NUDIX磷酸酶（NUDTs）也水解PP-InsPs。在此，我们剖析了三种不同磷酸酶家族对植物PP-InsP分解代谢和营养信号传导的相对贡献。我们报告了来自拟南芥（Arabidopsis）和地钱（Marchantia polymorpha）的肌醇焦磷酸磷酸酶的生化表征。过表达不同的PFA-DSP和NUDT酶会影响PP-InsP水平，并在拟南芥中导致生长受阻的表型。nudt17/18/21敲除突变体具有改变的PP-InsP库和基因表达模式，但没有明显的生长缺陷。相比之下，地钱Mp pfa-dsp1 ge 、Mp nudt1 ge 和Mp vip1 ge 突变体表现出与细胞PP-InsP水平变化相关的严重生长和发育表型。对Mp pfa-dsp1 ge 和Mp vip1 ge 的分析支持PP-InsPs在地钱磷酸盐信号传导中的作用，以及在硝酸盐稳态和细胞壁生物合成中的额外功能。同时去除两种磷酸酶活性会增强观察到的生长表型。综合来看，PPIP5K、PFA-DSP和NUDT肌醇焦磷酸磷酸酶通过共同塑造植物PP-InsP库，在生长和发育中发挥重要作用。

作者总结

生物体必须在其细胞和组织中维持足够的营养水平。其中一种营养是磷，它是细胞膜、核酸和能量代谢物的基本构建块。植物以无机磷酸盐的形式吸收磷，并需要足够的细胞磷酸盐水平来支持其生长和发育。已有研究表明，植物和其他真核生物利用肌醇焦磷酸信号分子来“测量”细胞磷酸盐水平。肌醇焦磷酸的浓度可作为细胞无机磷酸盐浓度的代理指标，因此肌醇焦磷酸的合成和降解必须受到严格调控。在此，我们报告三种不同的酶家族参与植物中肌醇焦磷酸的降解。不同的磷酸酶共同塑造细胞肌醇焦磷酸库，从而影响无机磷酸盐水平。不同酶的失功能突变体在硝酸盐水平和细胞壁结构方面表现出额外缺陷，表明肌醇焦磷酸调控的细胞过程超出了无机磷酸盐稳态的范围。
